description: WRITE: update fields on an existing task. Only the fields you pass are changed. ClickUp REST: PUT /task/{task_id}.

due_date.description: Due date as Unix time in ms.

due_date_time.description: Whether due_date carries a time component (else date-only).

parent.description: Parent task id (re-parent as a subtask).

start_date.description: Start date as Unix time in ms.

status.description: New status name (must be valid for the list).

task_id.description: The task id to update (path param, not body).

name: clickup_update_task
title: Update task
